К ЭМИГРАЦИИ ДАЛЬНЯГО ВОСТОКА

Эмигранты, надо быть безумцем, что бы не понимать того, что сейчас творится в России. Надо быть без глаз, как слепец, или иметь глаза и ничего не видеть, что бы не замечать налетъ подалеченной России,-убийствъ, разрушеній, казней, тюремъ, сумасшедших домовъ, чтобы не видѣть, до чего голодъ и ужасъ довели Россию. Надо быть без ушей, быть глухимъ, или иметь уши и не слышать рыданій, вздоховъ, плача женщинъ, раздирающаго крика дѣтей, хрипа душевныхъ людей и треска ружейныхъ выстрѣловъ палатей, всего того, что происходитъ въ Россіи. Пусть отдыхаютъ уставшіе, пусть слабовольные грѣются въ своихъ теплыхъ уголкахъ, пусть спятъ, кто можетъ въ эту страшную ночь, но вы бодрствуйте, съ имѣемъ храброе сердце, придите къ помощи, тѣмъ кто гибнетъ въ РОССІИ! К вамъ солдаты, казаки и офицеры нын обращеніе. К теб молодежь, цвѣтъ и гордость Россіи взываютъ РУССКІЙ НАРОДЪ. ПОМОГИТЕ РОССІИ!!! Неужели вы можете такъ спокойно смотрѣть на всѣ ужасы голода, холода и нищеты, которые переживаетъ народъ. Неужели ваше сердце камень, ваша совесть и сознанье угасли, что не видите всѣхъ ужасовъ. Неужели вы думаете, что свои свободныя и сытыя, находясь въ сторонѣ, вы сидя въ Китаѣ можно спасти Россію. Этимъ Россію не спасешь! Только безнадежные идіоты или извращенные личинки могутъ говорить, что еще время НЕ ПРИШЛО. Только СТРАХЪ за СВОЮ ШКУРУ заставляетъ говорить предательскимъ языкомъ.
Величайшій ПОЗОРЪ нашего времени, позоръ нашихъ руководителей, которые до сихъ поръ не могутъ понять, что русскій народъ въ оковахъ, голосъ народной воли заглушенъ, когда терроръ и тамъ и несчастной Россіи, нѣтъ силъ на открытую борьбу съ тираніей,-мы русскіе эмигранты должны всѣ силы своего разума, воли и чувства отдавать дѣлу помощи своему народу ЭМИГРАНТЫ! Послушайте заклинанія вашихъ верховъ и организаціяхъ руководителей! Или то грустное отчаянье въ три погибели, то вызывало насъ на новый ростъ убѣждаетъ, что время еще не настало. Опомнитесь, дражайшіе ничтожные балласты въ Новой Россіи, прилепившіеся къ тѣнямъ прошлаго не хотятъ нарушать свой покой, разжигать застарѣвшія болѣзни, а потому для нихъ всѣ несчастья Россіи ничто. Мы спрашиваемъ: что это низкая подлость? Такіе люди недостойны быть руководителями, этого изъ вида извратилась Россія. Вѣдь большинство же эмигрантовъ люди были военными, когда то присягали на вѣрность Государю и родинѣ своихъ жизней шли и умирали за ВЕЛИЧІЕ И МОГУЩЕСТВО РОССІИ. Но вѣрно курлыкали, шептали и говорили. ОТЪ РАЗГОВОРОВЪ ПОГИБЛА И НАША РОССІЯ. Организовались партіи, десятки, сотни, связывались другъ съ другомъ, составляйте отряды, проходите границу и помогайте русскому народу изнемогающему отъ свирѣпыхъ мучителей Россіи. К вамъ Жены, Матери, Сестры! СПАСАЙТЕ русскій НАРОДЪ! ПОМОГИТЕ СПАСТИ РОССІЮ! ПОСЫЛАЙТЕ своихъ мужей, сыновей, братьевъ на великій СВЯТОЙ ДѢЛО! Если они забыли о Россіи, то вы ихъ напомните, покажите имъ путь къ спасенію родины. Не медлите ни минуты, время НЕ ЖДЕТЪ! Каждый день, когда эмиграція ДОЛЖНА исполнять СВОЙ ДОЛГЪ передъ РОДИНОЙ. Посмотрите на руководителей, сколько такихъ эмигрантовъ, которые живутъ чужимъ трудомъ, а сами не желаютъ даже пальцемъ пошевелить. Но это пройдетъ! Нашъ народъ самъ освободитъ себя. Изгонимъ изъ среды нашей всѣхъ тѣхъ, кто предалъ Россію. Уничтожимъ всѣхъ тѣхъ, кто продалъ свою душу за кусокъ хлѣба. Впередъ ЭМИГРАНТЫ! ВЫРУЧАЙТЕ НА ПОМОЩЬ ПОРУГАННОЙ РОДИНѢ!
СПАСЕМЪ ЕЁ, ДРУЗЬЯ И БРАТЬЯ!! С НАМИ БОГЪ!

ОТЪ КОМАНДОВАНИЯ РОССІИ

April 11, 1929.

Anti-Bolshevik handbills.

Copies of handbills, translation of which is
attached, appealing to emigrants of the Far East,
have been printed in Harbin and sent to Shanghai to
some of the local White Russian organizations for
distribution.

Translation.

TO EMIGRANTS OF THE FAR EAST.

Emigrants, one must be insane not to understand that
which is happening in Russia to-day. One must be blind
or else have eyes and see nothing with them not to notice
on the features of mutilated Russia the murders, destructions,
grave-yards, prisons, lunatic asylums, or fail to perceive
to what a state starvation and terror have reduced Russia.
One must be minus ears or be deaf, or have ears and not hear
the sobbing, sighs, weeping of women, the cries of children,
the rattle of strangulated persons and the deafening noise
of rifle shots of the executioners, at the sight of happenings
in Russia. Let the fatigued rest, let the weak-willed
enjoy their comforts, let those who can sleep in the terrible
darkness of the night, but you, the vigilant and those who have
a brave heart, come to the assistance of those who are perishing
in Russia. Our appeal is to you, soldiers, cossacks and officers.
To you, young men, the pride of Russia, does the Russian People
appeal "HELP RUSSIA"!!! Is it possible that you can contemplate
with calmness all the terrors of starvation, cold and misery,
which the people are bearing. Have your hearts turned into
stone, your honour and conscience ceased exist that you cannot
see the horrors. Do you think for a moment that by means of
your enjoyments and revelry, memorial services and balls,
you being in China, can save Russia. This cannot save Russia!
Only hopeless idiots or incorrigible hypocrites can persist
in saying that the TIME HAS NOT YET COME. Only FEAR for
ONE'S OWN SKIN makes people contradict themselves. It is
the greatest SHAME of our time and shame to our leaders who
still fail to understand that the Russian nation is imprisoned,
that the voice of the people is stifled so long as the reign
of terror continues in the unfortunate Russia, and that the
people have no strength to oppose the tyrants themselves.
We, Russian emigrants, must give our people all the power
of our minds, wills and feelings. EMIGRANTS, do not listen
to the leaders who have seized power in the organizations. They
either cowardly bending forward or proudly lifting their
heads declare that the time has not yet come. They are
materialists and a useless element for the new Russia for,
having accustomed themselves to comforts they do not wish
to part from them, and hence the miseries of Russia mean
nothing to them. We ask - What is it? Treachery or madness?!
Such persons are not worthy of being leaders if they fail to
see the terrors and shame of Russia. The majority of
emigrants are former military men and at one time swore
allegiance to their Country and having no regard for their
own lives went and lay them for the GREATNESS AND POWERFULNESS
OF RUSSIA. Do not trust self-centred people and empty talkers.
RUSSIA PERISHED BECAUSE OF TOO MUCH TALK. Organize yourselves
into groups of fives, tens, hundreds and getting thus together
form detachments and cross the borders to help the Russian
people ready to save the desecrated Russia. To you Wives,
Mothers and Sisters does the Russian Nation APPEAL! HELP
TO SAVE RUSSIA! SEND your husbands, brothers and sons to
fulfil their duty. If they themselves have forgotten Russia
remind them of her. Brand all cowards wherever you meet them
and signify them as shameful men. Time is MOVING ON! The
moment has come when emigrants MUST FULFIL THEIR DUTY before
THEIR MOTHERLAND. Do not look up to the leaders - they are
people who are waiting for someone else to do something first
whilst they will follow when everything is ready. It will
not be thus! It is a question of now or never! You, young men,
who are strong, brave and courageous, show an example of love
for your country and the people. You have a kind heart, not
possessed by the dollar and you will sooner understand the
sorrows of Russia. EMIGRANTS, RISE UP IN DEFENCE OF DESECRATED
RUSSIA! SAVE FAITH, PEOPLE AND COUNTRY!!! GOD IS OUR HELP!

THE UNION OF REGENERATION OF RUSSIA.

Коммунизмъ умретъ! РУССКІЕ ЛЮДИ! Россія неумретъ!

Мѣсяцъ тому назадъ, послѣ длительной подготовки. изъ СССР, подъ ви домъ „высылки“, командированъ съ цѣлями планитарной провокаціи Троцкій
Мы получили недѣлю тому назадъ изъ Москвы братское предупрежденіе —Троцкій, старый коммунистъ, работаетъ все время въ единой коммунисти ческой партіи, составленной изъ самыхъ отбросовъ международнаго жулья у котораго есть одинъ законъ, одна заповѣдь: П Р О В О К А Ц І Я.
Мы утверждаемъ, что сидя въ Вѣрномъ, Трспкій руководилъ подготовкой краснаго похода въ Индію и ему удавалось почти захватить Авганпстанъ работая съ краснымъ Эмиромъ Амануллой. Вся же брехня объ оппозиціи— это средство провѣрки своихъ же коммунистовъ, кто изъ нихъ свое мнѣніе смѣетъ имть. Съ другой стороны, ввиду неизбѣжности краха комму нистической власти, вотъ уже шесть лѣтъ, какъ на смѣну теперешнимъ кра снымъ тиранамъ, готовятъ другихъ, разыгрывая комедію „ссылок“ и «преслѣ дованій», дабы вызвать къ нимъ сочувствіе враговъ коммунистовъ, обмануть еще и въ томъ, что «новые» будущіе московскіе комиссары—„троцкисты“ дескать, не отвѣтственны за все, что сдѣлано съ Россіей.
Теперь же, наряду съ указаннымъ планомъ, Троцкій долженъ связать ак тивность эмиграціи, спутать ея планы, обманувъ и спровоцировавъ ее и ино странцевъ. а если удастся, то поднять соціальную революцію въ Европе.
Эти же задачи выполняются и на Дальнемъ Востокѣ, гдѣ отъ ТРОЦКО ГО РАБОТАЕТЪ ГРУППА ПРОВОКАТОРОВ, ВЪ КОТОРУЮ ВХОДЯТЬ М О Р А В С К І И.
Самъ этотъ мелкій жуликъ не представляетъ ничего особенного, но за его спиной стоятъ большія акулы междувародного масонства.
Что же касается моравского, то
Э Т О тотъ Моравскій, который въ 1918 г. появился въ Сибири и прима зался къ бѣлому возстанію, а затѣмъ когда его, какъ паршиваго эсе- рншку выкинули изъ Омска.
О Н Ъ во Владивосток подбиваетъ Гайду поднять возстаніе противъ адми- рала Колчака. Во время этого бунта погибло болѣе 200 офицеровъ, которыхъ подвелъ Моравскій, Краковецкій и др. изъ группы провока- торовъ-эсеровъ, съ 1918 г. перешедшихъ на службу къ коммунистамъ и до сего времени имъ вѣрно служащая.
Друга Моравскаго—К Р А К О В Е Ц К А Г О, Коминтернъ заставили играть въ открытую и онъ съ 1921 г. состоитъ на офи- ціальной службѣ по Наркоминдлу.
МОРАВСКІЙ,— Коминтерномъ оставленъ для работы въ эмиграціи, чтобы пролезая въ блыя организаціи, разваливать ихъ и всячески мѣшать рус- скимъ людямъ за-границей, протянуть братскую руку помощи подневоль- нымъ русскимъ людямъ въ СССР. Но не удался подлому провокатору его подлые замыслы; въ 1928 г. онъ былъ окончательно разоблаченъ и выбро- шенъ изъ бѣлой Сибирской организаціи которую онъ пытался скомпромен- тировать дѣлая фальшивыя марки, за что Шанхайскимъ судомъ Французской концессіи былъ осужденъ на 3 мѣсяца тюрьмы и выселенъ изъ предѣловъ ея навсегда. Но онъ
УБІЙЦА— многихъ сотенъ русскихъ офицеровъ, своей провокаціонной ра- ботой уже много мѣшавшій бѣлому дѣлу, до сего времени обманы- ваетъ легковѣрныхъ русскихъ людей и сейчасъ, какъ истый провокаторъ- ФАЛЬШИВОМОНЕТЧИКЪ-подводить попавшихся ему на удочку русскихъ- офицеровъ подъ уголовную отвѣтственность.
Знайте русскіе люди, что этому прохвосту, сейчасъ, поставл- ена ударная задача вмѣстѣ, съ БУРЦЕВЫМЪ, КОВГАНОМЪ, НАРЕ- СТОУЛОВЫМ МЕТЕЛИЦЕЙ, ГЕНШТАБА ПОЛКОВНИКОМЪ ГУ ЩИНЫМЪ И РАФ ЛОВЫМЪ, и пр. работающими отъ Т р о ц- к а г о въ эмиграціи, - принять всѣ мѣры къ провокаціи бѣлыхъ начинаній, чтобы не дать возможности соорганизоваться истиннымъ врагамъ коммунизма.
РУССКІЕ ЛЮДИ на ДАЛЬНЕМЪ ВОСТОКѢ!
Будьте на страже!
Смотрите, чтобы эти жулики «троцкисты» не запутали-бы Васъ въ свои хитрыя сѣти. Братство Русской Правды. 20 МАРТА 1929 г.

Important negotiations are being carried on in
order to reach agreement on the privileges of foreign
representatives of ozone on the subject of commercial
political situation in the northern provinces,
to avoid and particularly the Chinese authorities.
The question to be solved is the economic and
political relations between Russia and Japan which
guarantee the revision of the Sino-Japanese agreements
of non-interference by Soviet Russia. Even
if an agreement is reached in the various aspects
which at present are of great importance continued or
the Soviet is quite in the promises made to refrain
from it. The representatives tried to explain that no
government can check every bit of political movement or
activities of its citizens, but the Chinese officials
require to the above as follows:
It is understood that it is impossible to watch the
political activity of every citizen of the country, but
when one citizen is arrested on the border of another
country and is found in possession of large quantities
of propaganda literature, it is permissible to ask
from where he has obtained such quantities of printed
matter and what was the punishment meted out to him by
the respective government or consulate? If there is
no such it means that the government authorizes anti-
Soviet activities affecting other countries which
have friendly agreements with it.
Failing to come to any better understanding concerning
the revision of the agreement concludes:
between Japan and Russia, the parties left the agreement
as it stands where politics and economics were concerned.
However with respect to the commercial management of
the railway considerable changes will be effected
referring to the engagement and dismissal of employees,
the extent of the duties of the manager, sub-managers,
departments, etc.
It is difficult to say what the changes actually will
result in, but one thing is certain and that is that
gradually communists will lose hold on the railway.
D. Waloff.

The Fraternity of Russian Truth.
(A Statement)

On March 20, 1928 handbills published by unknown
persons and alleged to emanate from the "The Fraternity
of Russian Truth" were distributed in Shanghai and other
cities of China.
The handbills comment on the provocative activities
of Trotsky and mention the names of Kamenev, Zinoviev,
Radek, Serebriakov, and others.
The Fraternity of Russian Truth has repeatedly
referred to the fact that various unknown persons often
make use of the title of the Fraternity and sign their
articles or handbills in its name.
In this instance again, without commenting on the
contents of the handbills dated March 20, 1928, the
Fraternity of Russian Truth wishes to declare that it has
no connection with the handbills in question and that
someone has again used their title for their own purposes.

Translation of a handbill distributed
in Shanghai (French Concession)
in March 1929.

Communism will die!             Russia will never die!

A month ago, after long preparations, Trotsky, under
pretext of "deportation", was sent out of the ...
for the purpose of well planned provocative activities.
He received a fraternal warning from Moscow a week ago
to the effect that Trotsky is an old-time communist and is
a strong adherent of the Party, which is composed of the
scum of international crooks whose one law and commandment is
"MYSELF FIRST".
We assert that whilst in Verny, Trotsky was at the head
of preparations for a Red campaign into India and he almost
took possession of Afghanistan in conjunction with the Red
Emir Amanullah. All talk of opposition is but a means of
testing Communists to know who will dare to have his own
opinion. Moreover in view of the inevitable fall of the
Communist power, during the past six years, substitutes have
been trained to take the place of the present red tyrants,
for which purpose 'exiles' and 'deportations' are represented
with a view to arousing the sympathies of the enemies of
Communism for them and also so that the future Moscow
Commissaries of Trotsky's lead should be exempt from blame
for the happenings in Russia.
At present, in accordance with the plan made, Trotsky
has to connect emigrant activities with the Soviet in such
a manner as to curtail these, spoil their plans, provoke
emigrants and foreigners and if possible to affect a
socialist revolution in Europe.
Similar plans are marked out for the Far East where
A MEMBER OF THE C.P.S.U. IS PLAYING THE PART OF TROTSKY,
INCLUDING BOROVSKY. This insignificant crook alone is
of little importance, but sparks of International Masonry
are at the back of him.
BOROVSKY is the man who appeared in Siberia in 1918
and joined in the White Uprising, but later when he was
expelled from Omsk he inspired Saida in Vladivostock for
an uprising against Admiral Kolchak. During that uprising
over 200 officers perished as a result of the activities
of Borovsky, Krakovetsky and other provocators, who since
1918 have joined the ranks of communists and are their faithful
servants.
KR. KOVATSKY, a friend of Borovsky, was compelled by the
Komintern to serve it openly and since 1921 he is officially
working in the Ministry for Foreign Affairs(People's Commissariat).
KORAVSKY has been assigned by the Komintern to 'work'
amongst the emigrants, so that penetrating in their organizations,
he may hinder their activities in every way and restrain
Russians abroad from extending a fraternal hand of assistance
to their Russian fellow citizens, prisoners of Bolshevism. The
shameful provocator, however, did not succeed in his plans.
In 1928 he was exposed and expelled from the White Siberian
Organization, which he attempted to compromise by printing
false stamps, for which offence he was sentenced by the
French Concession Court in Shanghai to 3 months' imprisonment
and deportation.

his provocative activities to the White movement, is still
continuing to mislead Russian people and now like a true
provocateur and ... is exposing Russian officers,
beguiled by him, to criminal responsibility.

scoundrel has now been entrusted together with ...,
..., A. STOULOFF POLITZ, GUDIN, Colonel of the

Beware against these crooks and followers of Trotzky
involving you in their spider's cobwebs.
THE WHITE ARMY OF RUSSIA.

April 4, 1929.

Translation of a handbill distribute
in Shanghai (French Concession)
in March 1929.

Trotsky will die! Stalin will never die!

After long preparations, Trotsky, under pretext of "deportation", was sent out of the U.S.S.R. for the purpose of well planned provocative activities. He received a fraternal warning from Moscow a week ago to the effect that Trotsky is an old-time communist and is a strong adherent of the Party, which is composed of the scum of international crooks whose one law and commandment is TROTZKY.

We assert that whilst in Verny, Trotsky was at the head of operations for a red campaign into India and he almost took possession of Afghanistan in conjunction with the Emir Amanullah. All talk of opposition is but a means of testing communists to know who will dare to save his own skin. Moreover in view of the inevitable fall of the Communist power, during the past six years, substitutes have been trained to take the place of the present red tyrants, for which purpose "exiles" and "deportations" are resorted to, a view to creating the sympathies of the enemies of communism for them and also so that the future successors of Trotsky's lead should be exempt from blame for the happenings in Russia.

At present, in accordance with the plans made, Trotsky has to connect emigrant activities with the Soviet in such a manner as to curtail these, spoil their plans, provoke emigrants and foreigners and if possible to effect a socialist revolution in Europe.

Similar plans are marked out for the Far East where TROTSKY IS THE HEAD OF THE OGPU OF TROTZKY, WORKING FOR V.K.Y. This insignificant area alone is of little importance, but sharks of international robbery are at the back of him.

V.K.Y is the man who appeared in Siberia in 1918 and joined in the White Uprising, but later when he was expelled from Omsk he inspired Gaida in Vladivostock for an uprising against Admiral Kolchak. During that uprising over 270 officers perished as a result of the activities of Moravsky, Krakovetsky and other provocateurs, who since 1918 have joined the ranks of communists and are their faithful servants.

KRAKOVETSKY, a friend of Moravsky, was compelled by the Komintern to serve it openly and since 1921 he is officially working in the Ministry for Foreign Affairs(People's Commissariat). MORAVSKY has been assigned by the Komintern to "work" amongst the emigrants, so that penetrating in their organisations, he may hinder their activities in every way and restrain Russians abroad from extending a fraternal hand of assistance to their Russian fellow citizens, prisoners of Bolshevism. The shameful provocateur, however, did not succeed in his plans. In 1928 he was exposed and expelled from the White Siberian Organisation, which he attempted to compromise by printing false stamps, for which offence he was condemned by the French Concession Court in Shanghai to 3 months' imprisonment and deportation.

- 2 -

However, as, the BEHAVIOR of many hundreds of Russian
officers, having caused a lot of detriment already by
his provocative activities to the White movement, is still
continuing to mislead Russian people and now like a true
provocateur and DOUBLE-DEALER is exposing Russian officers,
beguiled by him, to criminal responsibility.
Russian people be aware of the fact that this
scoundrel has now been entrusted together with KUTIEPOV,
FO-KI, a CHEKIST-AGENT, GUCHIN, Colonel of the
General Staff and RAKOFF as well as others, working on
behalf of Trotsky amidst emigrants, to do all in their
power to prevent real enemies of Communism, the Russian
Whites, from getting organized.
BE ON YOUR GUARD! Do not be caught off your guard!
Beware against these crooks and followers of Trotsky
involving you in their spider's cobwebs.
The WHITE GUARD INFORMATION BUREAU

March 4, 1929.
